name: SABnzbd

lifecycle.note: Active upstream; Docker Hub's LinuxServer version-5.1.3 tag contains the patched 5.1.3 release. Resolve its platform digest at install time.

security: Treat provider credentials, server configuration, and the SABnzbd API key as secrets.
Keep its WebUI private; the API key is accepted as a query parameter by the upstream API.
pitfalls: Provider access and retention are external operational dependencies.
Select completed and incomplete paths with the Arr import layout; differing paths or filesystems can prevent hardlinks or atomic moves.
